== Course of events ==

After the confrontation in the Nome King's underground palace, in which Dorothy took possession of the King's magic belt and the Tin Woodman was freed through Billina's revelation about the enchanted whistle, Dorothy turns to parting ways with her companions. She bids farewell to her friends in Oz, and Billina, the Yellow Hen, chooses to remain behind in Oz rather than continue on with Dorothy. Dorothy is then transported to Australia, where she finds Uncle Henry recovering from illness, and she comforts him as he mends.

This departure follows Dorothy's use of Ozma's magic picture, through which she saw Uncle Henry in Australia, sad and unwell, and resolved that she must go to him. It in turn precedes Glinda the Good's counsel that the magic belt functions only within fairy countries, after which Dorothy leaves the belt with Ozma, who will use its power to bring Dorothy back to Oz whenever she signals on a Saturday.
